editorial:
Imagine falling so hard for someone that you literally pass out when they get close. That is exactly what you get with Luna, a cute girl with pink braces who spends her days visiting Duncan Coffee House. She is totally smitten with Kaz, the cool and distant owner of the shop. The vibe here is sweet and cozy, focusing on the tension between Luna's nervous energy and Kaz's cold exterior. You will feel for Luna as she struggles with her panic attacks while trying to get noticed by her dream guy. It is a lighthearted story about secret crushes and the awkwardness of young love that feels very relatable.

What really works here is the chemistry between the leads and the way the coffee shop setting feels like a character of its own. The pacing is steady, though some parts feel a bit slow. You might find the love triangle with Akif a little frustrating, but it adds a good layer of drama. If you love romantic dramas, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the end, Luna stops hiding behind her games and finally opens up to Kaz. Kaz admits that her presence inspired his new menu and sparked real feelings in his heart. Even though Akif tries to come back into her life to win her over, Luna chooses the man who truly sees her for who she is. They share a sweet moment at the coffee house, proving that love can melt even the coldest hearts.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cozy romance stories and cute character dynamics.
